page_title: NEW 1-4 BOU | Newcastle v Bournemouth 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Here comes a substitution. Justin Kluivert is given a rest as he is replaced by Ben Winterburn (Bournemouth).
90+7' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Dango Ouattara and he is replaced by Remy Rees-Dottin (Bournemouth).
90+7' The expression of the referee Stuart Attwell is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) is shown a yellow card.

90+6' 1 - 4 Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Martin Dubravka is just a bystander as the ball flies into the right side of the goal. The score is 1:4.
90+5' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90+2' Stuart Attwell has issued a yellow card to Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth).

90+2' 1 - 3 Goal! Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) neatly controls a decent pass from Tyler Adams. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the left side of the goal from the edge of the box. 1:3.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and William Osula (Newcastle Utd) replaces Bruno Guimaraes.

90+1' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
90+1' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.

90' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bournemouth.
89' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.
87' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul after Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth) hacks down one of his opponents.
86' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Martin Dubravka, who smothers the ball.
84' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
83' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
82' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. David Brooks will be replaced by Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth).
79' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
79' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
77' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sees a yellow card from Stuart Attwell after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
74' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
74' The attendance is 52227.

72' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
72' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
72' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
70' The foul by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Stuart Attwell.

70' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Martin Dubravka makes a great save to stop his effort.
69' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for an infringement.
66' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) replacing Lewis Hall.
66' It's time for a substitution. Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) comes on in place of Jacob Murphy.
63' The resulting corner, taken by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth), comes to nothing.
63' After what seems an eternity, referee Stuart Attwell decides the ball went out of play after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Bournemouth, play to continue.
62' The goal for Bournemouth is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
61' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) meets a perfect cross from David Brooks deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 1:3.
59' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Stuart Attwell saw the whole situation.

57' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
56' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.

54' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
52' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
51' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Bournemouth earn a corner.

49' That was a nice football moment. David Brooks (Bournemouth) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the left post. Martin Dubravka guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
48' Bournemouth have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Eddie Howe probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd). He is replaced by Fabian Schar.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' The referee gives a yellow card to Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth).
45+5' The referee Stuart Attwell awards Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) a yellow card.
45+5' Today's referee Stuart Attwell rightly decides to book Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) for his harsh tackle.
45+2' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
45+2' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+1' David Brooks (Bournemouth) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Bournemouth can continue in their attacking effort.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Dango Ouattara laid the ball off to Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.

43' David Brooks (Bournemouth) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
43' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
41' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

41' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.

39' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
38' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
35' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
34' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd).
33' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) is penalised for a foul. Stuart Attwell had a clear view and blows his whistle.

31' That was close by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
31' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
29' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
28' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
27' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
27' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd).

25' 1 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the left post. The score changes to 1:1.
25' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner.
24' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
23' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

21' A short pass finds Joelinton (Newcastle Utd). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
21' Stuart Attwell blows for a foul after Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
20' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
19' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
18' The referee blows his whistle as Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in his challenge.
17' A lofted cross from Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
14' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Stuart Attwell stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
13' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
10' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
9' David Brooks (Bournemouth) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.

6' 0 - 1 Goal! Antoine Semenyo plays in Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 0:1.

4' The rebound finds Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
4' A tremendous drive by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Martin Dubravka makes a brilliant save.
3' David Brooks (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bournemouth are taking a throw-in.
3' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Stuart Attwell is the one to supervise the game today.
